concerns.text: FR-007 (exclude data gaps > 30 days from statistical analysis) lacks a dedicated task. T013 flags gaps but does not implement the exclusion logic required for the correlation calculation. The 'Edge Cases' section mandates exclusion, but no task explicitly implements 'exclude from correlation' logic.

FR-008 requires analyzing the trend of baseline amplitudes (absolute fluxes) against rigidity. T020 explicitly defers this ('Do NOT attempt to derive modulation amplitude trends here; this is performed in Phase 5'), but T029 (Phase 5) only fits a model to amplitudes derived from the *sinusoidal fit* (T028), not the *control analysis* amplitudes. The specific trend analysis for the control group (FR-008) is missing.

SC-003 requires measuring the width of the 95% confidence interval against stability. T027 implements resampling and T032 generates a report, but no task explicitly calculates the 'width' of the interval or performs the stability check against the null hypothesis (checking if interval includes zero).

Constitution Principle VII requires a 'documented lag analysis protocol'. T019 implements the calculation, but no task exists to generate the documentation artifact (e.,g, a methodology note or config validation) required by the Constitution.

T051 mandates Moving Block Bootstrap (MBB) for time-series validity. T027 (Phase 5) is marked complete but implements simple i.i.d. resampling. There is no task to refactor T027 to use MBB, creating a conflict where the existing code violates the requirement for valid time-series confidence intervals.

T049 proposes segmenting time series to exclude gaps from correlation degrees of freedom. T013 (Phase 3) only flags gaps. There is no task to update T013 or T019 to implement the segmentation and exclusion logic required by T049, leaving the gap handling logic inconsistent between the foundational and review-resolution phases.

T044 contains a comment 'FAILED: unspecified' and references a 'VERIFIED REAL DATA SOURCE' block that is not present in the current spec/plan. This task is currently unactionable as the trigger condition (verified source block) is missing from the inputs.
